_doc: The SDK-held file setup writes after a minted redeem (contracts/destination.md section 6a): the bytes below, mode 0600, at the path of credential-file-cases.json path_cases. lines is the file split on newlines (the file ends with one newline). The key is minted.credential; gateway_url and dashboard_url come from the redeem answer; destination is what the person chose (online here); expires_at is the answer's expires_at.
